verdict.rationale: CrewAI lets users specify agent goals and task descriptions in plain natural language, which agents then autonomously interpret and execute (crewai-docs-2/34, crewai-docs-17/33), but actually operating the product itself (installing, creating, running, testing crews) is done via structured CLI commands (`crewai create`, `crewai run`, `crewai test`) or Python/YAML config, not free-form natural-language commands to the tool. Missing for 10: a chat-style or NL command interface for controlling the framework/CLI itself, and any evidence that non-code users can direct crew setup/execution purely via natural language rather than code/CLI/visual builder.
